runtime.loader: GLTFParser.loadTexture(index); direct texture.source and sibling relative image URI, no EXT_texture_webp dependency
runtime.cacheKeyIdentity: v1 + original hero compressed-image SHA256 + effective mag/min filters + wrapS/wrapT + slot color space + UV channel + texture-transform SHA256
runtime.ownership: Both asset profiles must retain pooled textures until their last asset owner releases them.
runtime.colorSpace: srgb for baseColorTexture/emissiveTexture; linear (THREE.NoColorSpace) for data slots

totals.decodedMipCalculation: Exact RGBA8 sum from full-size level through 1x1, excluding driver/JS overhead

originalAttribution.textureNote: The existing source textures are at most 1024px; hero retains original image bytes without invented detail or skin tinting.
originalAttribution.units: Scale every variant by the desired adult standing height in metres. Raised hands may extend beyond this height.
